scores.claim_text: Distribution agreement with Amazon Braket; 84-qubit Ankaa-3 available on AWS Braket.
scores.M_check: Does Amazon (AWS) acknowledge Rigetti as a Braket partner in its SEC filings?
scores.M_value: Only 2 hits in Amazon EDGAR filings — both from 2020 8-K earnings-release exhibits (general AWS partner-tile coverage from the Braket launch era). Zero hits for product name 'Ankaa' in Amazon CIK. Amazon has not named Rigetti in any post-2020 10-K, 10-Q, or proxy.
scores.interpretation: Layer-3 Rule 7: hyperscaler distribution exists historically but is immaterial to Amazon. Rigetti's language is 'available via Braket', not 'commercial revenue from AWS-as-customer', so this is the MODERATE bucket per the rubric (distribution real, revenue scale tiny) — consistent with the 10-K describing partnerships, not headline AWS revenue.

scores.claim_text: Distribution agreement with Microsoft Azure Quantum.
supports: edgar_fts on MSFT CIK 0000789019 for 'Rigetti' and for 'Azure Quantum'
scores.M_check: Does Microsoft acknowledge Rigetti or even its Azure Quantum service in SEC filings?
scores.M_value: 0 hits for 'Rigetti' and 0 hits for 'Azure Quantum' in any Microsoft SEC filing (10-K/10-Q/8-K/DEF 14A/20-F) through 2026-05-16.
scores.interpretation: Counterparty disclosure threshold: a $3T issuer would not typically itemize one quantum partner, so absence alone is not RED. But Microsoft's complete silence on its own 'Azure Quantum' product line in SEC filings indicates Azure Quantum is a tiny, R&D-stage offering — Rigetti's revenue contribution from this channel is almost certainly de minimis. MODERATE per Rule 7.

scores.claim_text: Contracted partnerships with DARPA, AFRL, DOE/Fermilab, NASA.
scores.M_check: Are there federal contract/grant records matching the named-agency claims?
scores.M_value: USAspending: 10 contracts totaling $4.53M (all Department of Defense, award IDs FA8649*/FA8750*/FA8751* — AFRL Kirtland/Wright-Patterson contracting offices), descriptions include 'PHOTON-SUPERCONDUCTOR MULTI-NODE QUANTUM NETWORKS', 'HYBRID SUPERCONDUCTING-OPTICAL QUANTUM NETWORK NODES', 'RIGETTI CUSTOM QUANTUM FABRICATION'. Plus 2 grants: $2.31M DOE (DESC0021661, matches SQMS center claim) and $2.03M DoD (FA9550 = AFOSR).
scores.interpretation: Direct corroboration of the AFRL quantum-networking and DOE/SQMS partnership claims. DARPA/NASA contracts not visible here may be sub-prime or via a vehicle (consistent with 'multi-year contracts'). Aggregate ~$8.6M federal is small relative to FY25 revenue line but the named-agency claims themselves are verified. PASS.

scores.claim_text: Commercial customers/partners include AWS, Standard Chartered Bank, Moody's.
scores.M_check: Do Standard Chartered or Moody's mention Rigetti, or does a co-disclosure trail exist?
scores.M_value: 92 'Rigetti' hits across 10-K/20-F filings, but the top-10 are all Rigetti's own filings (10-K self + subsidiaries exhibit + Supernova SPAC). Standard Chartered Bank is a UK-domiciled foreign issuer not filing with the SEC; Moody's MCO files but a substring search at this depth does not surface a Moody's-as-counterparty mention. Cannot disprove the relationships but cannot independently corroborate from SEC filings.
scores.interpretation: Tier-1 financial customer claims are partnership/POC-stage based on language ('partners and customers include'), which the framework typically treats as ecosystem signaling rather than material revenue. Without SEC mention from counterparty and no PR-disclosure evidence in the 10-K of specific contract dollar amounts, this stays UNVERIFIABLE.

scores.claim_text: $8.4M C-DAC India purchase order (Jan 2026) for 108-qubit system, 2H 2026 deployment.
scores.M_check: Independent corroboration of the C-DAC order outside Rigetti's own disclosures; stage-ladder analysis of 108-qubit system.
scores.M_value: 0 third-party EDGAR hits — C-DAC is an Indian government R&D org and would not file with the SEC, so absence is expected. The order itself was company-announced and recently 8-K'd. The 108-qubit Cepheus-1-108Q is announced at 99.0% two-qubit fidelity vs 99.6% for the 36-qubit Cepheus-1-36Q — fidelity degrades with qubit count, which is consistent with stage-ladder behavior.
scores.interpretation: Calibration heuristic 3 (planned vs operational): the C-DAC system is *contracted to deliver* in 2H 2026 — i.e. fabricated-but-not-yet-deployed at filing date. The 108-qubit fidelity (99.0%) is at the level the 84-qubit Ankaa-3 hit, well below the 99.9% needed for QA. The $8.4M revenue won't show up as GAAP revenue until delivery acceptance. MODERATE — the purchase order is real but bookings-vs-recognized revenue gap is a Rule-11 quantum pattern.

scores.claim_text: Quanta Collaboration: parties each invest $250M over 5 years; Quanta bought ~$35M PIPE at ~$11.59/share in April 2025.
scores.M_check: Is the Quanta agreement disclosed (Form 8-K / exhibit)?
scores.M_value: edgar_fts returns 1 hit — Rigetti's own 2025-02-28 8-K exhibit (tm257789d1_ex10-1.htm) containing the Collaboration Agreement. Quanta Computer is a Taiwan-listed entity not subject to SEC filing, so co-disclosure outside is not expected. Internal disclosure (8-K + 10-K exhibit) is complete.
scores.interpretation: Calibration heuristic 4 (investment vs operating): the Quanta deal is a strategic investor + jointly-funded R&D commitment, NOT a customer revenue event. Useful capital ($35M PIPE) and credibility but not a 'design win'. The $250M-each commitment is forward-looking. Disclosure is properly contextualized in the 10-K; no overclaim detected. PASS.

scores.claim_text: 121 issued patents and 160 pending as of Dec 31, 2025 in quantum/superconducting-qubit IP.
scores.M_check: USPTO open-data corroboration of patent counts and technology categorization.
scores.M_value: USPTO ODP returns 114 granted patents (vs 121 claimed — small difference likely due to non-US patents in 10-K count) and 310 total applications. CPC codes are heavily concentrated in G06N 10/xx (quantum computing), H10N 60/xx (superconducting/Josephson junctions), B82Y 10/00 (nanotechnology), confirming claimed technology areas. Recent grants include 'Voltage-Assisted Annealing to Alter Tunnel Junction Properties' (12/2025), exactly the type of fab/process IP one would expect from Fab-1.
scores.interpretation: Heuristic 8: n_granted >= 10 with hits in claimed technology area = PASS. Patent claim is materially accurate and well-corroborated. Not a Nikola-pattern (no orphan-IP red flag).

scores.claim_text: 84-qubit Ankaa-3 (99.0% 2Q fidelity) and 36-qubit Cepheus-1-36Q (99.6% 2Q fidelity) deployed on QCS.
scores.M_check: Stage-ladder calibration: are these benchmark-tested, paying-customer-accessible, or marketing milestones? Logical-vs-physical clarity?
scores.M_value: All fidelity figures explicitly labelled 'based on internal testing' — no third-party benchmark (e.g. Quantum Volume, CLOPS, mirror-RB) cited. Cepheus-1-36Q is described as 'available to our partners via Rigetti QCS' (not 'paying commercial customers'). 108-qubit Cepheus is announced at 99.0% fidelity, same as 84-qubit Ankaa-3 a year earlier — qubit-count growth without fidelity gain. 'Quantum Advantage' defined as 1,000+ qubits at 99.9% + 50ns; current systems are >2 orders of magnitude away.
scores.interpretation: Calibration heuristic 3 (planned vs operational) + heuristic 9 (physical vs logical): all reported qubit counts are PHYSICAL. Heuristic 11 (revenue recognition): only $5.7M in 2025 Novera POs and $8.4M C-DAC order — tiny relative to capex and burn. The headline qubit numbers are real fabricated systems but the marketing implication (commercial scaling) is not supported by counterparty disclosure or revenue. MODERATE.

scores.claim_text: $216.2M FY25 net loss, $771M accumulated deficit, $583M cash + investments, $350M ATM completed.
supports: 10-K MD&A and balance sheet self-disclosure (no external M-source required)
scores.M_check: Is the cash-runway claim internally consistent and is there going-concern fingerprint?
scores.M_value: Cash + ST + LT AFS = $38.7M + $398.7M + $146.3M = $583.7M. Operating cash burn FY25 = $58.5M (lower than headline GAAP loss because non-cash includes derivative warrant remeasurement). At $58.5M opex burn, runway is ~10 years on cash alone; even at the higher accounting-loss rate ~$216M/yr, runway is ~2.7yr. Heuristic 10: filings list contains no Form 15, Form 25, no reverse-split 8-K, audit opinion is clean.
scores.interpretation: Liquidity is robust thanks to opportunistic equity raises ($350M ATM in 2025 + $35M Quanta PIPE + $50M warrant exercises). No going-concern signal. PASS — disclosure is internally consistent and balance sheet is well-capitalized for a pre-revenue R&D-stage company. Note: net loss is amplified by non-cash warrant fair-value remeasurements (typical post-SPAC artifact).
